adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff introduces pagination but takes `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` with no clamping/validation, then passes them directly into `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)`. This allows arbitrarily large limits (and potentially `LIMIT -1` depending on DB) and negative offsets/limits reaching SQL, which can cause errors (e.g., negative OFFSET) or effectively disable pagination and dump the full membership list. The diff shows no upper bound or floor being applied.
